settings.polling_order: axis ascending, minus then plus; fresh incumbent each sweep

diagnostic.method: independent all-assignment XOR enumeration and algebraic phase/bit-pair mixer evolution

groups.method: ideal circuit-sampling simulation; no QPU execution
groups.shot_weighted_counts_semantics: modeled preparations/operations, not measured hardware consumption

validation.objective_convention: minimize negative sample mean of joint cut; optimum not used in decisions

quality_bound.scope: fixed final states, conditional on training; simultaneous ideal-sampling union bound over every final group
quality_bound.excludes: optimizer convergence, physical faults and coherent synthesis approximation

device.backend: CPU Qiskit Statevector, NumPy PCG64 ideal sampling and independent dense references

parent_provenance.revision_note: Checkout revision identifies the base; captured content hashes identify executed code

selection: first heldout-supported four-wire QAOA run in frozen case/start/seed order
selection_scope: data-dependent choice protected by the full simultaneous final-group family

negative_controls.physical_workload_scope: only selected run; all other runs/CPU controls remain uncompiled archived evidence
